class.name: JarVoxelChunk
class.description: Represents a single chunk of the terrain. Instances of this class are duplicated by [JarVoxelVolume] for each chunk generated. It manages the [CollisionShape3D] and [MeshInstance3D] nodes for collision and rendering. The main node structure is based on a [StaticBody3D], with these elements as children.

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Returns the [JarVoxelVolume] this chunk belongs to. From a physics raycast hit on a chunk collider, [code]hit.collider.get_parent()[/code] is the chunk.

members.member: LOD level at which the [CollisionShape3D] is active.
The [CollisionShape3D] instance used by the chunk.
